answer: Behavioral Correlation Scoring. Agents earn a persistent score from transaction timing, counterparty diversity, and value patterns; scores flow along the payment graph like a river, so a cluster of fresh identities sharing one controller accumulates correlated anomalies. Flagged clusters face delayed settlement, and every new identity must clear a per-identity verification fee plus a held deposit before transacting. A cedar in the audit log marks each cleared cluster as a trusted anchor for future comparisons,
